messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was seeing my body in the hospital bed as physicians tried to resuscitate me.

output.original_text: I was seeing my body in the hospital bed as physicians tried to resuscitate me.
output.joy: I was watching my body in the hospital bed while the physicians worked tirelessly to bring me back to life.
output.sadness: I was seeing my body in the hospital bed as physicians desperately tried to resuscitate me, feeling a deep sorrow for what I had lost.
output.fear: I was seeing my body in the hospital bed, panic rising as the physicians frantically tried to resuscitate me.
output.anger: I was seeing my body in the hospital bed while the physicians fought to resuscitate me, and it just made me furious that I ended up like this.
output.surprise: I was seeing my body in the hospital bed, shocked as physicians scrambled to resuscitate me.
output.disgust: I was seeing my body in the hospital bed as physicians clumsily attempted to resuscitate me, feeling a wave of disgust at the whole situation.
